_comment: Static cluster registry for local dev/testing (set CLUSTERS_CONFIG_FILE pointing to this file). No hub K8s cluster needed. Values below reflect the actual Pinniped Concierge CRs — check your cluster with: kubectl get jwtauthenticator -A

clusters._comment_id: REQUIRED — unique ID used in API paths: /api/v1/clusters/{id}/token, /credentials, etc.
clusters._comment_name: OPTIONAL — UI display name. Defaults to id.
clusters.name: your_cluster_name_for_display
clusters._comment_api_server: REQUIRED — spoke cluster API server URL. This spoke cluster is shared with Concierge as ImpersonationProxy, or KubeAPI at port 6443
clusters._comment_ca_bundle_file: REQUIRED when spoke uses a private CA. Path to PEM on disk. Export from kubeconfig: kubectl config view --raw --minify -o jsonpath='{.clusters[0].cluster.certificate-authority-data}' | base64 -d > spoke-ca.crt
clusters._comment_audience: REQUIRED for /token and /credentials. Must match spec.audience of the JWTAuthenticator CR on this spoke cluster. The Supervisor embeds this as the 'aud' claim in the cluster-scoped id_token issued via RFC 8693 token exchange. Each cluster MUST have a unique audience to prevent cross-cluster token reuse.
clusters._comment_jwt_authenticator_name: REQUIRED for /credentials (mTLS cert from Concierge TokenCredentialRequest). Must match metadata.name of the JWTAuthenticator CR. Check with: kubectl get jwtauthenticator -A
clusters._comment_issuer_url: OPTIONAL — Pinniped Supervisor OIDC issuer URL. Required for generating a pinniped CLI exec-credential kubeconfig via /kubeconfig.
clusters._comment_concierge_endpoint: OPTIONAL — Pinniped Concierge API endpoint. Defaults to api_server when omitted. Required for pinniped CLI exec-credential kubeconfig.
clusters._comment_upstream_idp_name: OPTIONAL — Pinniped Supervisor upstream IDP name. Run: kubectl get oidcidentityproviders -n pinniped-supervisor to find the name.
clusters._comment_upstream_idp_type: OPTIONAL — Upstream IDP type: oidc | ldap | activedirectory | github.
